chapter.title: JURISDICTION OF THE CRIMINAL COURTS IN INQUIRIES AND TRIALS

heading: Power to order cases to be tried in different sessions divisions.
text:
Notwithstanding anything contained in the preceding provisions of this Chapter, the State Government may direct that any cases or class of cases committed for trial in any district may be tried in any sessions division: 1.Ins. by Act 45 of 1978, s. 15 (w.e.f. 18.12.1978).
Provided that such direction is not repugnant to any direction previously issued by the High Court or the Supreme Court under the Constitution, or under this Code or any other law for the time being in force.
status_note: The Act is repealed. Kept in India Code's 'Repeal Acts' collection; record title reads 'The Code of Criminal Procedure 1973, 02 of 1974 (Rep., Act 46 of 2023)' (read 2026-11-21)
